ChargebackBot: ALERT: Dispute opened by cardholder for charge ch_88221. Reason: unauthorized_transaction. Amount: $3,600.00. Dispute ID: dsp_5580.

Maya: Customer (Neptune Labs, acct neptune-212) called AM claiming they didn't authorize the payment. They emailed us a refund request and attached a screenshot of their bank dispute. @Jon can you pull order details and login/session evidence?

Jon: Pulling now. Payment metadata:
``
charge_id: ch_88221
amount: 3600.00
card_last4: 6789
processor: BlueGate
created_at: 1812552000
invoice: INV-2026-410
``
I see a successful SSO login from user anna@neptune.ai at purchase time and device fingerprint match on two subsequent logins. IPs: 18.200.34.12 & 18.200.34.15 (both geolocated to Seattle, match company HQ).

RiskTeam: Check for account takeover markers: sudden email change, multiple failed logins, new payment method added. Also confirm if billing email equals corporate domain.

Jon: Billing email is finance@neptune.ai. No recent password reset, no email change. New card was added 02 days prior by the user id 8321 which maps to Anna's employee record.

Maya: AM confirms procurement approved purchase and we've got a signed SOW on file (SOW-1221). Sending to Legal.

Legal: Gathered items for rebuttal: SOW-1221, signed PO PO-3344, invoice INV-2026-410, SSO assertion log, IP traces, support chat transcript where user confirms order. Redact any PII not required. We can file rebuttal to BlueGate.

RiskTeam: Also run card BIN and cardholder history — same BIN has been used for past vendor charges by Neptune. No pattern of fraud.

Maya: I'll inform the customer that we're investigating and won't refund until review complete, but we can offer provisional credit if needed. Uploading packets to ticket dsp_5580: https://redwood.internal/finance/disputes/dsp_5580/evidence.zip

ChargebackBot: STATUS: evidence uploaded, awaiting Legal sign-off. BlueGate response window ~60 days.

Legal: Filing rebuttal now (submission_ref sub_7766). Keep account in hold for provisioning changes until resolved.

Maya: Marking P1 and closing communication loop with AM. Will update once network responds.
